title: answers what the check answered, and leaves no timer
why: The timer left running after a check that answered: every folder check, log wait and shutdown step would hold the process open until its deadline.

title: keeps the deadline it is handed
why: A deadline other than the one handed in (here the folders' five seconds as a ceiling, the old default leaking): a site with a longer bound would give up early.

title: keeps the deadline it is handed
why: The check's answer never raced: everything waited out its whole deadline and lapsed, a check that answered in time included.

title: gives up on work that never finishes after the time it is given, and never rejects
why: `within` as a bare `inTime`: a log that fails to flush or close would reject, and a quit or a diagnostics copy waiting on it would fail with it.

title: stops an engine that ignores the shutdown request by ending it
why: `waitFor` reading a lapse as the engine having ended: an engine that ignores the shutdown request is never terminated, and outlives the app.

title: refuses the copy when the home through its links does not answer in time
why: The home's lookup lapsing read as an answer: the copy goes ahead with the deadline's symbol for the real home, and a real home in the text is never hidden.

find: if (info === LAPSED) throw new Error(`no answer within ${ENGINE_INFO_TIMEOUT_MS / 1000} s`)
title: gives up on an engine that does not answer, and says so
why: An engine.info that lapsed taken as its answer: the copy no longer says the engine gave no answer within five seconds.

title: gives up on a project’s folder that never answers: the flag comes down
why: The reset's checks given a deadline other than the folders' one: it gives up before FOLDERS_TIMEOUT_MS, on a folder that might still have answered.

title: gives up on a project’s folder that never answers, names the project
why: The engine folder's choice given a deadline other than the folders' one: it has not given up at FOLDERS_TIMEOUT_MS.

find: const judged = await inTime(judgeDestination(folder, where, asking), FOLDERS_TIMEOUT_MS)
replace: const judged = await inTime(judgeDestination(folder, where, asking), FOLDERS_TIMEOUT_MS - 1)
title: refuses the folder when the deadline lapses, and says which folder did not answer
why: A project's folder judged with a deadline other than the folders' one: the refusal comes before FOLDERS_TIMEOUT_MS.
